title: FILETH Bridge
tagline: A bridge to send tokens between Filecoin and other blockchain
description:
A bridge to send tokens between Filecoin and other blockchains powered by Filecoin EVM.
 
FILETH Bridge dApp is a decentralize bridged where users can swap, change and receive tokens across blockchains. With FILETH Bridge transactions are fast, low-cost, and eco-friendly. 

FILETH Bridge dApp takes advantage of the Filecoin EVM to confirm transactions instantly and process thousands of transactions per second.  

Please try our app and join us to change the way we interact with the world. 

How it works:
- When the bridge wallet receives tokens from the Ethereum Goerli side of the bridge, it will mint new tokens in the Filecoin Wallaby side and send them to the target user wallet address.
- When the bridge wallet receives tokens from the Filecoin Wallaby side of the bridge, it will burn those tokens and transfer back the same amount of tokens from the bridge wallet to the target user wallet address.
how_its_made:
We built the Dapp with React and use Chakra UI for styling.  I built the contract with Remix.  I deploy my contracts on Filecoin Wallaby and Goerli Testnet.  I built the server with Node.js which will listen to tokens received in the bridge wallet.  

I used the following technologies:
- FEVM - I deployed the contract on Filecoin Wallaby Testnet for a cheap gas fee
